description: Read the MAINTENANCE WORK ORDER. workOrderId: one work order by its id, with its status, whether an authority record is on file for the place, the active cycle, each need and what it waits for, whether a cycle reads accepted and, only where the place is shown, the NET it stands for and which jobs are linked, never a wallet. On a keyless read the place is shown only as a 350 metre cell, and only for public ground a listed verifier has confirmed; the holder's own signed reply shows their place. view counts: how many work orders stand, how many jobs are linked and where (a 350 metre cell is listed only for public ground a listed verifier has confirmed), never a wallet and never an id. With nothing passed, the counts are read. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, and until then the counts say so plainly; a work order that exists can be read at any time. For a place that is not shown the NET figure reads Not shown and the links name no job; the holder's own signed reply and signed list always show them. This tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

workOrderId.description: One work order's id (the id it was planned under).
